name: VANE
description: Automated OpenFAST linearisation post-processing, physics-aware mode identification, and state-space export for digital twin development of fixed-bottom and floating offshore wind turbines.

name: CableDyn
description: Cable and mooring dynamics solver for floating offshore wind turbines, including lazy-wave configurations, verified against OrcaFlex static and dynamic response at the sag, hog, and touchdown regions. Also integrated into a fork of OpenFAST v5.0.0 as a first-class mooring module.

name: CableXsec
description: Cross-section analysis of layered dynamic power cable constructions, computing the stiffness and mechanical properties required for global dynamic analysis.

name: FOWCON
description: A gain-scheduled, damage-aware LQR DISCON runtime for floating offshore wind turbines.

name: fowt-moor-dt
description: A digital twin framework for FOWT mooring systems: Kalman-filter-based tension estimation from platform motion, virtual sensing along the line, and probabilistic fatigue assessment.

name: pyULSAN
description: Differentiable ultimate strength analysis of stiffened panels built on JAX, enabling gradient-based optimisation and sensitivity analysis of hull structural elements.

name: pyBModes
description: A Python finite-element library for wind turbine blade and tower modal analysis, targeting OpenFAST and ElastoDyn. Also distributed through conda-forge.

name: pyIECWind
description: A Python package for IECWind-style IEC wind condition generation for OpenFAST InflowWind.

name: OpenFAST, ROSCO and TurbSim syntax highlighting for VS Code
description: Syntax highlighting for OpenFAST input files and ROSCO controller input files in Visual Studio Code.
